---
title: "报告溯源信息"
---

以下溯源区块由引擎自动锚定，随报告留痕：

```{python}
#| echo: false
from datetime import datetime
from html import escape

from IPython.display import HTML, display

import bioreport
from bioreport.registry import get_registry
from bioreport.utils.report_utils import load_provenance

prov = load_provenance() or {}

_BUILTIN_TITLES = {
    "ai": "AI 解读", "about": "关于", "faq": "常见问题",
    "license": "许可", "trademark": "商标", "provenance": "溯源信息",
}
_LAYOUT_NAMES = {"single": "single（单文件）", "website": "website（多页面）"}
_FORMAT_NAMES = {"html": "HTML", "pdf": "PDF"}
_REGISTRY = get_registry()


def _esc(value):
    return escape(str(value))


def _module_chip(module_id):
    canonical = _REGISTRY.canonical(module_id)
    if canonical in _REGISTRY.modules:
        title = _REGISTRY.modules[canonical].title
    else:
        title = _BUILTIN_TITLES.get(module_id, module_id)
    return (
        "<span class='prov-chip' title='模块 ID: " + _esc(module_id) + "'>"
        + _esc(title) + "</span>"
    )


def _human_time(iso):
    """ISO8601 -> 2026年10月15日 19:34 (UTC+8)，完整 ISO 存 title。"""
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(iso)
    except Exception:
        return _esc(iso)
    offset = parsed.strftime("%z")
    if parsed.tzinfo is not None and offset:
        utc = "UTC" + f"{int(offset[:3]):+d}"
        text = (f"{parsed.year}年{parsed.month}月{parsed.day}日 "
                f"{parsed.hour:02d}:{parsed.minute:02d} ({utc})")
    else:
        text = iso
    return "<span title='完整时间 (ISO8601): " + _esc(iso) + "'>" + _esc(text) + "</span>"


_ICONS = {
    "项目 ID": "bi-tag",
    "生成引擎": "bi-cpu",
    "生成时间": "bi-clock",
    "报告模块": "bi-collection",
    "输出布局": "bi-window",
    "输出格式": "bi-file-earmark",
    "分析流程版本": "bi-diagram-3",
}


def _item(label, value_html):
    if not value_html:
        return ""
    icon = _ICONS.get(label, "bi-dot")
    return (
        "<div class='prov-item'>"
        "<span class='prov-ico'><i class='bi " + icon + "'></i></span>"
        "<div class='prov-item-body'>"
        "<div class='prov-label'>" + _esc(label) + "</div>"
        "<div class='prov-value'>" + value_html + "</div>"
        "</div></div>"
    )


_version = prov.get("bioreport_version") or bioreport.__version__
_modules = prov.get("rendered_modules") or []
_formats = prov.get("output_format") or []
_layout = prov.get("layout", "")

_items = [
    _item("项目 ID", "<span class='prov-version' style='color:#4f46e5'>" + _esc(prov.get("project_id", "")) + "</span>"),
    _item("生成引擎", "<span class='prov-version'>BioReport v" + _esc(_version) + "</span>"),
    _item("生成时间", _human_time(prov["generated_at"]) if prov.get("generated_at") else ""),
    _item("报告模块", "".join(_module_chip(m) for m in _modules)),
    _item("输出布局", _esc(_LAYOUT_NAMES.get(_layout, _layout))),
    _item(
        "输出格式",
        "".join(
            "<span class='prov-fmt'>" + _esc(_FORMAT_NAMES.get(fmt, fmt)) + "</span>"
            for fmt in _formats
        ),
    ),
    _item("分析流程版本", _esc(prov.get("pipeline_version", ""))),
]

_checksums = prov.get("input_checksums") or {}
_fp_rows = ""
for _key, _digest in _checksums.items():
    _short = str(_digest)[:12] + "…"
    _fp_rows += (
        "<div class='prov-fp-row'>"
        "<span class='prov-fp-name'>" + _esc(_key) + "</span>"
        "<span class='prov-fp-right'>"
        "<code class='prov-fp-hash' data-hash='" + _esc(_digest) + "' title='" + _esc(_digest) + "'>"
        + _esc(_short) + "</code>"
        "<button type='button' class='prov-fp-copy' data-hash='" + _esc(_digest)
        + "' title='复制完整 SHA256'><i class='bi bi-clipboard'></i><span>复制</span></button>"
        "</span></div>"
    )
if _fp_rows:
    _fp_body = (
        "<div class='prov-fp-list'>" + _fp_rows + "</div>"
        "<div class='prov-fp-note'>指纹用于核验数据是否被篡改；点击「复制」可获取完整 SHA256。</div>"
    )
else:
    _fp_body = "<div class='prov-fp-empty'>未采集到输入文件指纹（本报告可能由旧版本引擎生成）。</div>"

_html = (
    "<div class='prov-card'>"
    "<div class='prov-head'>"
    "<div class='prov-head-left'>"
    "<span class='prov-shield'><i class='bi bi-shield-lock-fill'></i></span>"
    "<div><div class='prov-title'>报告溯源信息</div>"
    "<div class='prov-subtitle'>Provenance</div></div>"
    "</div>"
    "<span class='prov-status'><i class='bi bi-check-circle-fill'></i>自动采集 · 不可修改</span>"
    "</div>"
    "<p class='prov-desc'>本区块由 BioReport 引擎在报告生成时自动锚定、随报告留痕，"
    "用于科研可复现与合规审计。</p>"
    "<div class='prov-grid'>" + "".join(_items) + "</div>"
    "<details class='prov-fp' open>"
    "<summary class='prov-fp-summary'>"
    "<i class='bi bi-fingerprint'></i>输入文件指纹"
    "<span class='prov-fp-count'>共 " + str(len(_checksums)) + " 项</span>"
    "<i class='bi bi-chevron-down prov-fp-chevron'></i>"
    "</summary>"
    "<div class='prov-fp-body'>" + _fp_body + "</div>"
    "</details>"
    "</div>"
    "<style>"
    ".prov-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6ebf2;border-radius:14px;"
    "box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(34,51,74,.06);padding:1.4rem 1.6rem 1.2rem;"
    "color:#22334a;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.6}"
    ".prov-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;"
    "gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}"
    ".prov-head-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem}"
    ".prov-shield{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;"
    "width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:#eaf1fb;color:#2f6fb3;font-size:1.25rem}"
    ".prov-title{font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;color:#1d2c40}"
    ".prov-subtitle{font-size:.8rem;color:#7a8aa0;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}"
    ".prov-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;"
    "background:#f0fdf4;border:1px solid #bbf7d0;color:#15803d;"
    "border-radius:999px;padding:.25rem .8rem;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}"
    ".prov-desc{margin:.9rem 0 1.1rem;color:#5b6b80;font-size:.9rem}"
    ".prov-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1.1rem 2.2rem;margin-bottom:1.2rem}"
    ".prov-item{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:flex-start}"
    ".prov-ico{flex:0 0 auto;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;"
    "width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;background:#eaf1fb;color:#2f6fb3;"
    "font-size:.9rem;margin-top:.05rem}"
    ".prov-item-body{min-width:0}"
    ".prov-label{color:#7a8aa0;font-size:.85rem;white-space:nowrap}"
    ".prov-value{color:#22334a;min-width:0}"
    ".prov-version{color:#2f6fb3;font-weight:700;font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace}"
    ".prov-chip{display:inline-block;background:#eaf1fb;color:#2f6fb3;border-radius:999px;"
    "padding:.12rem .7rem;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;margin:0 .3rem .3rem 0}"
    ".prov-fmt{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #cfe0f5;color:#2f6fb3;border-radius:6px;"
    "padding:.05rem .55rem;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;margin-right:.35rem}"
    ".prov-fp{border-top:1px solid #edf1f6;padding-top:.9rem}"
    ".prov-fp-summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;"
    "color:#1d2c40;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;user-select:none}"
    ".prov-fp-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}"
    ".prov-fp-count{background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b;border-radius:999px;"
    "padding:.05rem .6rem;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:500}"
    ".prov-fp-chevron{margin-left:auto;color:#7a8aa0;transition:transform .2s ease}"
    ".prov-fp[open] .prov-fp-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)}"
    ".prov-fp-body{margin-top:.8rem}"
    ".prov-fp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;"
    "padding:.42rem 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #eef2f7}"
    ".prov-fp-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}"
    ".prov-fp-name{font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;"
    "font-size:.85rem;color:#40536b;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;"
    "white-space:nowrap;flex:0 1 auto}"
    ".prov-fp-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;flex:0 0 auto}"
    ".prov-fp-hash{display:inline-block;width:12em;text-align:center;background:#f1f5f9;"
    "border-radius:999px;padding:.15rem .8rem;"
    "font-family:'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.82rem;color:#2f6fb3;"
    "white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}"
    ".prov-fp-copy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;border:1px solid #dbe4ee;"
    "background:#fff;color:#64748b;border-radius:6px;padding:.15rem .6rem;font-size:.78rem;"
    "transition:all .15s ease;flex:0 0 auto}"
    ".prov-fp-copy:hover{border-color:#2f6fb3;color:#2f6fb3}"
    ".prov-fp-copy.copied{border-color:#16a34a;color:#15803d;background:#f0fdf4}"
    ".prov-fp-note{margin-top:.7rem;color:#93a1b3;font-size:.8rem}"
    ".prov-fp-empty{color:#93a1b3;font-size:.88rem;padding:.4rem 0}"
    "@media (max-width:640px){"
    ".prov-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}"
    ".prov-fp-hash{width:9.5em}"
    "}"
    "</style>"
    "<script>"
    "(function(){"
    "var card=document.querySelector('.prov-card');"
    "if(!card){return;}"
    "card.addEventListener('click',function(ev){"
    "var btn=ev.target.closest('.prov-fp-copy');"
    "if(!btn){return;}"
    "var hash=btn.getAttribute('data-hash');"
    "var done=function(){btn.classList.add('copied');"
    "var label=btn.querySelector('span');var old=label?label.textContent:'';"
    "if(label){label.textContent='已复制';}"
    "setTimeout(function(){btn.classList.remove('copied');"
    "if(label){label.textContent=old;}},1500);};"
    "if(navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText){"
    "navigator.clipboard.writeText(hash).then(done).catch(function(){"
    "var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=hash;"
    "document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();"
    "try{document.execCommand('copy');}catch(e){}"
    "document.body.removeChild(ta);done();});"
    "}else{"
    "var ta=document.createElement('textarea');ta.value=hash;"
    "document.body.appendChild(ta);ta.select();"
    "try{document.execCommand('copy');}catch(e){}"
    "document.body.removeChild(ta);done();}"
    "});"
    "})();"
    "</script>"
)

display(HTML(_html))
```
